latest_release.name: firmware-2026-11-05
latest_release.body:
### Changes in this release:
- 5a2631c dfu: bump to 2.0.1
- 7d4a2a1 cameras: move cinnado d1 t32lq to experimental
- 90e7f1a linux: build only uImage.lzma for T32 4.4.94 kernels  Backport 727f16228. uImage is a symlink to its first prerequisite, so uImage.lzma is the only image ever shipped. Building the lzo, zrt and jzlzma variants just discards the result, and jzlzma runs the prebuilt x86-64 helpers under scripts/ingenic_hardlzma/, which fail with "Exec format error" on aarch64 build hosts.  Signed-off-by: Paul Philippov <paul@themactep.com>
- d6dded4 add divinus streamer package
